title: The never ending basement.
content: Anyone else ever get this one? It's usually in a house I'm staying at where there is some kind of malevolent presence, either demonic or a literal monster sometimes. The basement has a sub basement, which has another sub basement and it just keeps going down so far as I can tell endlessly. It gets creepier and weirder the further down I go and always feel like something is there watching me and waiting for me to go further. The furthest down I've gone felt like a prison, there is no light but shapes are outlined with colored lines. Not sure how to describe it exactly except to compare it to drawing with colored chalk on black paper. I ended up in a room I couldn't get out of on the periphery of a square shaped corridor, and I felt like there were rooms all around me with other trapped people. I kinda forgot why I was there and it felt like Hell, or like you're one of those nurses that gets trapped in a locked room in Silent Hill. (I don't believe in religious stuff so I don't think it was Hell, I know it's all just a dream). Just thought I'd ask if anyone else had this particular weird thing happen in their dreams. It's a recurring situation in many of mine.
